title: Perfect State Transfer from a Localised Two-Excitation State to a Dicke State via Static Spin-Network Hamiltonians
summary: I construct a family of time-independent, excitation-preserving spin Hamiltonians realising perfect state transfer from a localised two-excitation state to the symmetric two-excitation Dicke state, for every $N\ge4$. The Hamiltonian has the physical form $H=\sum_{i<j}J_{ij}(σ_i^+σ_j^-+σ_j^+σ_i^-)+\sum_iε_i n_i$ with real couplings, and satisfies $e^{-iHt}|110\cdots0\rangle=e^{iφ}|D_N^{(2)}\rangle$ at a finite time.
